t.a: Log in with a one-time code (OTP)

div.t:
First time? Type your Patient ID in both boxes (Patient ID and Password), then create your own password.
Forgot your password? Log in with a one-time code and create a new one.

First time or forgot your password? Log in with a one-time code sent to your registered mobile / e-mail, then create a new password. If you have no registered mobile or e-mail, please ask the reception to add one.
